entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order VF-994821. Just tell me if I can or can't.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered eight days ago. To get this started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit. I took them on one ride and got horrible blisters. I can't use them.
I'm very sorry to hear that. A proper fit is critical. Did you have a chance to adjust the cleats or the tension dials, or is it the overall shape?
I tried everything. It's the shoes. Look, I just want my money back. Can I get a refund, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Great. So you're sending a label?

Yes. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just pack up the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Also, I see you're a VIP member. For the trouble, I've added a complimentary $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Oh. Okay, a credit is fine. I've got the email. Thanks for being quick about it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
